notes: RULED BY CHAD 2026-09-24: CARTRIDGES ARE OUTSIDE BOTH CHANNEL SPLITS. Refilling is an ongoing buy-and-deliver relationship, not distribution of the device, and neither partner has any reason to be in it. Cartridges are sold 100% through a designated Baen-owned outlet or company. This closes Husteem's claim (salon customers refilling through her) and Rosznar's Article IV claim alike: Article IV grants exclusive mass-market distribution of the DEVICE, and a separate seller of a separate consumable under separate patents (WD-494-005 sealed, WD-494-006) is not distributing it. THE BOOKED CASE IS NOW DIRECT SALE: fuel overtakes Shi'van's 46,800 gp/yr device income in YEAR FOUR (55,580), not year six. At the current ~3,800 base it is ~9,500 gp/yr, all hers. IP ROUTE: ESAMT holds the patents and licenses them to Baen Innovations, which is already the Promethean revenue recipient - the natural seller. OPEN AND CHEAP: which outlet. It matters more than it looks, because the 4-6 refills/yr assumption depends on refills being where the users are. 300 of every 376 devices are 8 gp Common Pattern lighters carried by dockhands; a single refill counter in Sea Ward luxury retail (Blackwatch Lane) would suppress the refill rate on exactly the units that make up the base. Dock Ward presence, or cartridges stocked through ordinary chandlers on a wholesale basis, protects the number. Wholesale through third-party shops is still not a channel split - it is a sale at a wholesale price.
